Module com.project.coursework2
Package com.project.coursework2.model

Class Booking

java.lang.Object
com.project.coursework2.model.Booking
public class Booking extends Object
Immutable data-transfer object representing a resource booking. Maps directly to a row in the Booking database table. Status values are pending, confirmed, cancelled, and completed.
